 Dakota News Now presents: The 2026 First Alert Winter Weather Awareness Special 
 Winter is coming. The First Alert Weather Team is highlighting some of the things to keep in mind to ease some of those holiday-season headaches. By Phil Schreck , Tyler Roney , Lexie Merley and Jason Lilek Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 8:20 AM CST | Updated : 16 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google SIOUX FALLS, S.D. (Dakota News Now) - The inevitable has happened: the warm temps and long sunny days have come to an end, and winter is coming. The First Alert Weather Team is highlighting some of the things to keep in mind to ease some of those holiday-season headaches.
 First Alert Meteorologists Tyler Roney and Jason Lilek will go over tracking El Niño and how it could affect this winter, and will show you around the First Alert Weather App, which is available for iPhone and Android.
 Brian Van De Rostyne from Nyberg’s ACE shows you ways you can ensure your home is ready for winter, and tools that can come in handy. Brian also has tips on preparing your vehicle for emergencies.
 Chief Meteorologist Phil Schreck will go over the differences between watches, warnings and other advisories. First Alert Meteorologist Lexie Merley chats with Marv’s Body Shop owner Evan Kindt about how you can stay safe on the road during winter weather. 
 Our team will also go over plow safety, winter weather resources, and health risks during winter, like crashes, slips and falls.
 You can watch this year’s First Alert Winter Weather Awareness Special in the video player above.
